topic: document-only save_document MCP tool and Wave 2 save/search SRS

agents.focus: MCP tool usability across Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenHands, and smaller models

subagentReview.commonVerdict: A separate save_document tool is the correct product direction, but the first SRS iteration needed stricter path, schema, redaction, response, and gate contracts before implementation planning.

resolvedFindings.finding: projectPath and path-bearing inputs were ambiguous and could leak local paths.
resolvedFindings.resolution: FR-DOC-027 and IR-MCP-017 reject projectPath, filePath, sourceFilePath, path, savePath, outputPath, destinationPath, directory, and mcpAutoSavePath. They introduce gitContextPath as transient local-only metadata context that is never persisted or echoed.
IR-MCP-017 and CON-MCP-006 require additionalProperties=false or equivalent strict rejection, plus explicit forbidden field conformance across stdio, HTTP, and generated bundle.

resolvedFindings.finding: tags versus documentTags was too weak for smaller models.
resolvedFindings.resolution: IR-MCP-017 and CON-MCP-006 require model-visible descriptions stating documentTags are persistent document metadata and tags are viewer/window grouping metadata not accepted by save_document.

resolvedFindings.finding: MCP scope overview and Wave 2 gate still referenced seven-tool smart_search contracts.
resolvedFindings.resolution: docs/spec/50.mcp-integration.srs.md now describes strict 8-tool save/search parity. CON-ARCH-005 supersedes CON-ARCH-004 and gates Wave 2 on IR-MCP-017, CON-MCP-006, SEC-DOC-003, and OPS-ARCH-008.

resolvedFindings.finding: save_document response identity was too loose.
resolvedFindings.resolution: FR-DOC-027 and IR-MCP-017 require documentId in every success response, with sourceRelativePath or redactedPath as a separate external identity.

resolvedFindings.finding: indexing.jobId might be mistaken as a control handle.
resolvedFindings.resolution: IR-MCP-017 and CON-MCP-006 require jobId to be described and tested as diagnostic-only, never as a status, cancel, retry, or rebuild handle.

resolvedFindings.finding: storage containment and path_policy_violation behavior were under-specified.
resolvedFindings.resolution: FR-DOC-027 defines lexical resolve checks, realpath or ancestor containment, traversal and drive/UNC rejection, symlink/junction escape rejection, and path_policy_violation outcomes.

resolvedFindings.finding: post-save indexing enqueue failure semantics were underspecified.
resolvedFindings.resolution: FR-DOC-027 separates file save success from indexing enqueue. Enqueue failure keeps saved=true and returns indexing.state=enqueue_failed with warning code index_enqueue_failed.
SEC-DOC-003 supersedes them with one deterministic redaction policy for save_document, smart_search, diagnostics, logs, exports, backups, and package smoke artifacts.

resolvedFindings.finding: OPS-ARCH-006 package smoke still referenced the seven-tool contract.
resolvedFindings.resolution: OPS-ARCH-008 supersedes it with eight-tool save/search package smoke covering save_document strict schema, smart_search limit/defaults, native load, and redaction fixtures.

nextEvaluation: Run a second three-subagent evaluation against the replacement requirements and SpecKiwi validation output.
